artifact_name: Stage 6M Development Variance Calibration & Sizing Record

data_sources.description: Historical Common Voice 27 acoustic benchmarks across 6 canonical strata

statistical_derivation_summary: For simultaneous Bonferroni control across M=9 hypotheses (alpha_adj = 0.005556, z_crit = 2.539) and SE(Delta_D) = sqrt(2)*3.20/sqrt(78) = 0.512 pp, 90% power (z = 1.282) requires an effect size Delta_D <= -(2.539 + 1.282) * 0.512 = -1.96 pp. The empirical CV27 shift between US English (-2.5 pp) and Irish English (-4.5 pp) provides Delta_D = -2.00 pp, which achieves 90.2% joint power in 500 Monte Carlo simulations at N=78 speakers/stratum.
